shared_elements: schematic animal/human figures in profile or silhouette
upright figures standing on a horizontal element
justification: Both surfaces show highly schematic figures set against a rock ground, and both place figures standing above a horizontal line or ledge, but that is about the extent of the correspondence. A shows a boat with upturned prow and stern carrying two featureless silhouetted humans, while B shows a dense stacked assemblage of animals — quadrupeds in profile, a large bird with folded wings, snake-like and reptilian forms — plus registers of repeated abstract signs, with no boat, no human figures, and a relief modelling convention rather than flat filled silhouette.
